# Silero regression corpus

These eight purpose-written texts exercise long spaces, dialogue, quiet consonants,
short words, foreign insertions, numbers, punctuation and a paragraph. They contain
no extracts from the user's books. Fixture texts are dedicated to CC0.

`audio/` contains 24 kHz lossless FLAC before/after examples for xenia and aidar.
`audio/report.json` records their decoded PCM hashes, generation environment and
which outputs changed. The recordings are generated by the pinned Silero v4_ru
model: credit **Silero Team / snakers4/silero-models**. Model weights have their
[own CC BY-NC terms](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-models#licence); this project
makes no claim that the model or every generated recording is covered by its MIT
source-code license. This corpus is provided for regression review, with upstream
attribution retained.

Reproduce from the checkout with the Silero extra and ffmpeg installed:

```sh
python silero_regression.py --output /tmp/silero-corpus
```

The command verifies native/reference equality, sample count, finite output and
unchanged word-token spectra using the real model. Checks CI repeats it with
CPU PyTorch 2.6.0 and the latest supported 2.x, and uploads each version's audio.
Compare measurements within a single run; rounding may differ between runtimes.

**Manual listening review is pending.** Listen to both versions at 1x and 3x,
check quiet consonants and beginnings/endings of words, unwanted sounds in pauses,
and natural transitions. Record the reviewer, environment and observations below;
structural tests and low pause RMS do not establish perceptual quality.
